composition.serve_who: This is a spare-parts photo of a Harken needle roller bearing (part A72931800, qty 2, dimensions 20x26x19), packaged in a labeled bag referencing PO Number "SWS108#1 ID13398" and order code SWS108. The bearing is a generic Harken winch service spare — no specific winch unit is named on the label, so it cannot be attributed to a single specific winch node. Given the Harken brand and winch context of the register (multiple Harken B1111.3/B1235.3 winches and Harken Captive/CT1 items exist on this vessel), the most fitting general destination is the winches/deck gear category; since no specific winch is named, this is recorded as a general Harken spares item without forcing attachment to one specific winch unit.
